blocks.text: A container query checks the size of a chosen parent box. A card can adapt to a narrow sidebar even on a wide screen.
Use the runnable HTML examples here, then resize a local browser page or its device preview. The CSS examples are inside each small page, so no framework is required.

blocks.title: Respond to a component width

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `container-type: inline-size` makes this ancestor available for queries about its inline width.
The `@container` rule checks a chosen ancestor container, so the component can adapt even inside a narrow sidebar.

blocks.text: The card switches to a row when its container, not the viewport, is at least 25rem wide.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A size container query needs a container-type on an ancestor. It does not measure the element it is changing here.
